gloss_en: bara — the Hebrew verb 'created' (second word of Genesis 1:1), denoting the act/entirety of creation; in LM 22 it is the revealed 'half utterance' (aspect of son, Torah, lower Wisdom) relative to 'Bereishit,' the complete utterance of before-creation

outliers.actual_gloss_en: son (Aramaic), as in the dictum 'b'ra kar'a d'avuha' — the son is the leg of his father
outliers.reason: Partner is כרעא (leg) and context concerns one who has no children and the wife as 'foot' — this is the Aramaic noun 'son,' a homograph of the Hebrew verb 'created.'
